title: cyclodium serra
intro: Cyclodium serra, commonly known as Serra Palm, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Serra Palm include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
